Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Watch

手表

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you wear a watch?

Not anymore, actually. I used to wear a smart watch, mainly for tracking my runs. The thing is, I didn't end up running much, so it felt unnecessary. Now I just check my phone.

以前戴智能手表是为了记跑步，但没怎么跑，就觉得没必要，现在只看手机。

Q2Have you ever got a watch as a gift?

Never, honestly. I've received clothes and gadgets as gifts, but never a watch. I guess my family and friends just don't think of watches when they're choosing presents for me.

从没收过手表做礼物，家人朋友挑礼物时一般不会想到手表。

Q3Why do some people wear expensive watches?

I think it's mostly about status and image. An expensive watch is a visible symbol of success, and for some people it's also a kind of investment or collection. It's more about showing off, I suppose.

主要是地位和形象，贵表是成功的象征，也有人当投资或收藏。

Q4Do you think it is important to wear a watch? Why?

Not really, to be honest. Since everyone has a phone these days, checking the time is never a problem, so a watch doesn't seem necessary. For me personally, it's just an extra thing to carry.

不太重要，人人有手机随时看时间，对我来说手表只是多带一样东西。
